description: Retrieval evaluation queries for an architecture-catalog agent over the Tessera 'atlas' OKF bundle (+ shared engineering standards). Second-domain fixture for agent-agnosticism (WP0). Graded relevance: 2 = must appear, 1 = acceptable. distractors are near-duplicates that should rank BELOW the grade-2 concept. All queries were written from the generated text before any search run (added: wp0). split is the seeded 70/30 dev/heldout assignment stratified by category x lang; the plan gates this fixture on its full set until it reaches 150 queries. sectionAnchor marks queries whose answer lives in one section of one concept (WP3a).

categories.nl-task: Natural-language task sentence, as an engineering agent would phrase a question mid-task
categories.mixed-lang: Query mixing Italian and English terms
categories.exact: Exact-string lookup: incident key, ADR number, topic, hostname, error code, path
categories.morph: Morphological variant of indexed words (singular/plural, verb forms)
categories.accent: Accent variant: query without the accent the text has (or control with accent)
categories.synonym: Paraphrase using words that do not occur in the relevant text
categories.freshness: Current concept expected above a deprecated or superseded twin
categories.disambig: Near-duplicate disambiguation by version, language, sibling or type
categories.standards: Expected concept lives in the shared standards bundle (project mode only)
categories.no-answer: Plausible agent question with no relevant concept; the system should return nothing or score low
